name: progress_predictor

assumptions.skill_prior: Beta(2, 2) latent skill per learner for the target concept
assumptions.p_correct: sigmoid(6 * (skill - difficulty_offset)) * (0.45 if holding the misconception else 1.0)
assumptions.diagnosis_confidence: U(0.55, 0.95) when the wrong answer comes from the held misconception, else U(0.2, 0.6)
assumptions.probe: asked when confidence < 0.7; answer matches the misconception with p=0.9 when held, 0.1 otherwise
assumptions.intervention: after 2 diagnosed wrong answers; abandons the misconception with p=abandon_rate (U(0.2, 0.7))
assumptions.learning: skill += learn_rate (U(0.01, 0.06)) after each correct answer, capped at 1
assumptions.reassessment: after each intervention: 3 transfer + 1 trap, correctness from the same p_correct at medium
assumptions.horizon: 10 observed steps, outcome measured after 10 further steps

feature_method: history features over the first 10 practice steps
label: Estimate based on simulated learners, not validated on real students.
